proposed.explanation: When existing drainage infrastructure is insufficient, on-site stormwater management (retention/detention) is standard practice to control runoff and prevent downstream flooding. This is now a core site planning component. Overloading an already-insufficient system is not a responsible solution. Elevation is a complementary flood mitigation strategy but does not address the root drainage problem. Density reduction addresses runoff volume but is not required if on-site stormwater management is designed.
